decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already captures the new leak-free acceptance condition for both plumbing paths during continuous operation.
A same-message MODIFY already captures the requirement for both stations to operate simultaneously.
Dispensing from both spouts is specified as demonstration content and does not change the existing dispensing mechanism, sequence, flow, or per-station controls.
The demonstration instructions and plumbing repair precondition do not alter the BOM deliverable or any component selection.
The source changes the operational demonstration criteria, not the system-layout or CAD deliverable.
The startup and shutdown demonstration element does not modify the electrical wiring-plan deliverable.
Several minutes of operation is a video demonstration criterion and does not revise the existing prolonged-use or maximum-speed duty constraints.
Showing that speed adjustment functions is an acceptance-demonstration requirement and does not change the established speed range, maximum speed, or operating modes.
The plumbing repair and leak-free demonstration do not change the dispensing path's cleaning, removal, sanitation-access, or liquid-trap requirements.
The revised demonstration list does not alter the required mixing quality, foam performance, whisk configuration, or high-speed mixing behavior.
Requiring dispensing from both spouts in the video does not change their geometry, material, mounting location, orientation, or pour direction.
The source does not introduce or revise any splash-control target or mitigation method.
